lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلصَّآخَّةُ is in the derivative form: صَاخَّة
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ص/خ/خ   ṣ–kh–kh deafening sound, a cry that deafens by its vehemence; to pierce; calamity. Of this root, 1 form, صاخّة ṣākhkhatun, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
صَاخَّة ṣākhkhatun [act. part./n.] that which deafens by its vehemence; the cry on the occasion of which the Resurrection will take place, the calamity of the Resurrection

(80:33–4) فَإِذَا جَاءَتِ الصَّاخَّةُ يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ when the Deafening Blast comes–the Day when one will flee from one’s own brother.
